description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to search, browse or compare GIF choices. Search by emotion, character or brief phrase and show up to 6 choices with optional copy/share controls. For the assistant's own conversational GIF response, use react_with_gif instead. Send only short keywords; omit personal data and conversation transcripts. This searches existing GIFs; it does not create images or send messages.

limit.description: Number of GIF choices to browse.

query.description: Two to six search keywords for the current topic and action, such as cheeseburger hungry, cat laughing, friendly wave, or laughing. Keep concrete subjects: a burger conversation should not become generic excitement. For a laughter-only or emoji-only follow-up, use its present emotion, e.g. laughing; do not carry forward an old object such as burger unless the user mentions it again. No personal information or transcript.

name: search_gifs
title: Find GIF reactions
